## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD2: filter_bridge_events skips filtering entirely when bridge_env_id is empty (back-compat pass-through), unit-tested with bridge_env_id=\"\" and a mix of env_id=\"\" and env_id=\"real-uuid\" events

## What
Add a failing test to tests/scripts/test_bridge_outbound.py that asserts filter_bridge_events returns ALL events (including those with env_id=\"\") when bridge_env_id=\"\".

## Why this test currently FAILS
Current filter_bridge_events in plugins/dso/scripts/bridge/_outbound_api.py:78-94 iterates events and keeps only those whose env_id != bridge_env_id. When bridge_env_id=\"\", events with env_id=\"\" match and are filtered out. Pre-migration events have env_id=\"\" and are silently dropped — this is the bug.

## Test approach
Given: events = [{\"env_id\": \"\", ...}, {\"env_id\": \"real-uuid\", ...}] (one pre-migration, one normal)
When: filter_bridge_events(events, bridge_env_id=\"\")
Then: both events are returned unchanged (no filtering when bridge_env_id is empty)

## Implementation
In tests/scripts/test_bridge_outbound.py, add:

def test_filter_bridge_events_back_compat_when_bridge_env_id_empty(bridge):
    \"\"\"filter_bridge_events passes all events through when bridge_env_id is empty.
    Pre-migration events have env_id=\"\" and must not be filtered when bridge_env_id is unset.\"\"\"
    events = [
        {\"ticket_id\": \"t-pre-migration\", \"event_type\": \"STATUS\", \"env_id\": \"\"},
        {\"ticket_id\": \"t-with-uuid\", \"event_type\": \"CREATE\", \"env_id\": \"real-uuid-1234\"},
    ]
    result = bridge.filter_bridge_events(events, bridge_env_id=\"\")
    ticket_ids = [e[\"ticket_id\"] for e in result]
    assert \"t-pre-migration\" in ticket_ids, \"Pre-migration events (env_id='') must not be filtered when bridge_env_id is empty\"
    assert \"t-with-uuid\" in ticket_ids, \"Events with env_id must not be filtered when bridge_env_id is empty\"
    assert len(result) == 2, \"All events must pass through when bridge_env_id is empty\"

Update .test-index with RED marker:
[test_filter_bridge_events_back_compat_when_bridge_env_id_empty] for plugins/dso/scripts/bridge/_outbound_api.py

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Test test_filter_bridge_events_back_compat_when_bridge_env_id_empty exists in tests/scripts/test_bridge_outbound.py
  Verify: grep -q \"test_filter_bridge_events_back_compat_when_bridge_env_id_empty\" tests/scripts/test_bridge_outbound.py
- [ ] Test FAILS before the implementation change (confirms it is a proper RED test)
  Verify: python3 -m pytest tests/scripts/test_bridge_outbound.py::test_filter_bridge_events_back_compat_when_bridge_env_id_empty 2>&1 | grep -q \"FAILED\\\|failed\"
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED marker [test_filter_bridge_events_back_compat_when_bridge_env_id_empty] for plugins/dso/scripts/bridge/_outbound_api.py
  Verify: grep \"\\[test_filter_bridge_events_back_compat_when_bridge_env_id_empty\\]\" .test-index
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
